'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Soledar]]
***[[Ukraine]] announces defeat at [[Soledar]] after days of intense fighting. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/ukraine-confirms-that-russia-has-taken-control-of-disputed-town-of-soledar/ar-AA16nYjG?li=BBnb7Kz (MSN)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[Tigrayan peace process]]
***[[Amhara Region|Amharan]] Special Forces announce their withdrawal from the [[Tigray Region]] in line with an [[African Union]]-backed [[Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement|peace agreement]] between the [[Government of Ethiopia|Ethiopian government]] and the [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]]. *[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**The [[Somali Armed Forces]] claim to have recaptured the port town of [[Harardhere]] from [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants. According to a [[Puntland]] officer, Somali forces allied with regional militias also recaptured the town of [[El Dhere]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[International Kite Festival in Gujarat – Uttarayan]]
** At least six people including three children died and 176 people were injured from cuts and falls while flying kites during Uttarayan festival in [[Gujarat]]. Some bled to death as revellers used sharp strings that entangled around the necks. [https://m.tribuneindia.com/news/nation/6-killed-176-injured-in-kite-flying-incidents-during-uttarayan-festival-in-gujarat-470920 (The Tribune)]
*Nineteen people are killed and 24 others are injured during a collision between a bus and a truck in [[Sakal Arrondissement]], [[Senegal]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/16/people-dead-after-bus-collides-with-truck-in-senegal (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Goshen shooting]]
**Six people, including a baby, are killed in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Goshen, California]], [[United States]]. The shooting is believed to have been perpetrated by cartel members. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/16/us/goshen-california-massacre-six-dead/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Metropolitan Police]] [[Parliamentary and Diplomatic Protection]] officer [[David Carrick (serial rapist)|David Carrick]] pleads guilty to 49 offences, including 24 [[rape in the United Kingdom|rapes]], at [[Southwark Crown Court]] in [[London]], [[UK]]. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-64289461 (BBC News)]
*[[Sicilian Mafia|Mafia]] [[Crime boss|boss]] [[Matteo Messina Denaro]], one of the most wanted men in [[Italy]] and [[Europe]], is arrested in [[Palermo]], [[Sicily]], [[Italy]], after 30 years [[fugitive|on the run]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64288928 (BBC News)]
*[[Solomon Peña]], a former [[Republican Party of New Mexico|Republican]] candidate for the [[New Mexico House of Representatives]], is arrested by [[SWAT]] officers for his role in the shootings of at least four [[Democratic Party of New Mexico|New Mexico Democrat]] politicians' houses. [https://apnews.com/article/solomon-pena-gop-arrested-fbed4efadff3bc7469f83a01dd888e63 (AP News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[LGBT rights in Scotland]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] says that it will block the [[Gender Recognition Reform (Scotland) Bill|Gender Recognition Reform Bill]] passed by the [[Scottish Parliament]] despite objections from [[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]], saying that the proposed law would conflict with "equality protections" across [[Great Britain]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-64288757 (BBC News)]
*[[Germany|German]] [[Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)|Defence Minister]] [[Christine Lambrecht]] [[resign]]s from the [[Scholz cabinet]] amid criticism of her response to the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|war in Ukraine]].
